$comment: Portable runtime-admission corpus for .ores-lock.toml. Config snippets are TOML text so every runtime and repository auditor can exercise the same cases without deriving one peer authority from the other.

cases.toml:
schema_version = "ores.lock.config.v1"
default_profile = "local-install"
selected_profile_env = "ORES_LOCK_PROFILE"

[[env]]
key = "ORES_LOCK_PROFILE"
kind = "string"
required = false
secret = false
purpose = "Select the lock profile."

[[env]]
key = "ORES_LOCK_ROOT"
kind = "path"
required = false
secret = false
purpose = "Local lock rendezvous root."

[[profiles]]
profile_id = "local-install"
wait = true
wait_timeout_ms = 30000
retry_interval_ms = 50

[profiles.providers]
local_file = true
fiducia = false
pg_advisory = false

[profiles.local_file]
root_env = "ORES_LOCK_ROOT"
require_existing_root = false

schema_version = "ores.lock.config.v1"
default_profile = "service-composed"

[[env]]
key = "FIDUCIA_BASE_URL"
kind = "url"
required = false
secret = false
purpose = "Fiducia authority endpoint."

[[env]]
key = "FIDUCIA_AUTH_TOKEN"
kind = "string"
required = false
secret = true
purpose = "Fiducia credential."

[[env]]
key = "DATABASE_URL"
kind = "string"
required = false
secret = true
purpose = "Postgres connection string."

[[profiles]]
profile_id = "service-composed"
wait = true
wait_timeout_ms = 30000
retry_interval_ms = 50
ttl_ms = 30000
renew_interval_ms = 10000

[profiles.providers]
local_file = false
fiducia = true
pg_advisory = true

[profiles.fiducia]
endpoint_env = "FIDUCIA_BASE_URL"
auth_token_env = "FIDUCIA_AUTH_TOKEN"

[profiles.postgres]
database_url_env = "DATABASE_URL"
scope = "transaction"
